digest.component_or_area: ruff linting configuration and datetime/timezone handling
propositions: Enable Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rule families in the global configuration after resolving all 6 existing diagnostics across src/rebar and tests

Replace datetime calls in validate_checks.py with explicit UTC timezone handling: epoch seconds via fromtimestamp(tz=datetime.timezone.utc) and timezone-less strings via strptime().replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
Replace security-pin timestamp logic to obtain aware current instant with explicit tz argument, convert to host timezone, and extract local date for cadence comparison
Create tests/unit/test_ruff_ratchet.py to assert ASYNC/DTZ selection, prohibit datetime.UTC token in src/rebar, ban security selector S, and reject Semgrep config files
Prove UTC timestamp semantics via tests that validate epoch and timezone-less paths under multiple TZ environment values using time.tzset on supported platforms
Resolve drift-introduced ASYNC/DTZ diagnostics in test_jira_onboard.py, test_review_bot.py and verify zero diagnostics on ruff check --select ASYNC,DTZ src/rebar tests
